stemMd: A company will replace its customer hotline with online forms. It expects all current hotline users to retain a usable way to seek help. Which assumption is necessary?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every current hotline user can use an online form or has access to an effective alternative assistance route.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every form will receive an immediate response.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Online forms are cheaper to operate.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The company receives fewer complaints than its competitors.

explanationMd: The universal conclusion requires a route for every current user, including those unable to use the new channel directly. A cheaper system or majority preference cannot establish that nobody loses usable access.

distractorRationale.e: Complaint volume does not determine accessibility.
distractorRationale.c: Usability need not require an immediate answer.
distractorRationale.d: Cost does not ensure user access.
distractorRationale.a: Most is insufficient for the claim about all current users.
